json_ld.description:
Dark green frames built for the loudest hole in golf and the longest days in the desert. Polarized smoke lenses cut the glare as the sun climbs and the crowd gets rowdy, while embedded rubber nose pads keep everything locked in from first tee to last cheer. Finished with a desert outline on the arms and a 16th hole lens etch, this pair is made for fairways, grandstands, and whatever happens after the final putt drops. Equal parts grit and gold because at TPC Scottsdale, subtlety never wins. Limited edition. When the tournament’s over, so are these.

Polarized smoke lenses
Full UV400 eye protection
Embedded green rubber nose pads
Dark green frame with desert outline on arms
16th hole logo lens etch
Rubberized finish
Gold K logos
Microfiber lens cleaning pouch included
FDA compliant impact resistant lenses
